definitions.explanation: The amount of money paid regularly for the use of a house, apartment, or other residence.

examples.japanese: {家賃|やちん}は{月|つき}に10{万円|まんえん}です。
examples.english: The rent is 100,000 yen per month.

examples.japanese: {東京|とうきょう}は{家賃|やちん}が{高|たか}い。
{家賃|やちん}を{滞納|たいのう}してしまった。
examples.english: I fell behind on my rent.
examples.notes: 家賃を滞納する = to be behind on rent

notes:
USAGE: {家賃|やちん} specifically refers to residential rent. For office or commercial rent, {賃貸|ちんたい}{料|りょう} or テナント{料|りょう} may be used.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{家賃|やちん}を{払|はら}う (to pay rent)
・{家賃|やちん}が{高|たか}い/{安|やす}い (rent is expensive/cheap)
・{家賃|やちん}を{滞納|たいのう}する (to be behind on rent)
・{家賃|やちん}{込|こ}み (rent included)

RELATED:
・{敷金|しききん} (security deposit)
・{礼金|れいきん} (key money/gift money)
